purpose: Complete 822-grade-route dispatch matrix. It is an action queue and structural crosscheck, not technical answer adjudication or qualified independent review.

source_first: Use raw uploaded XLSX question/options as authority for source-native examination; do NOT mistake rewritten canonical app for uploaded original
Preserve original correct answer KEY as imported but mark not official-authenticated
Read exact same-object normative paragraph and immediate before/after context
Vet option A, B, C and A/B A/C B/C pairs including qualifying/negative examples
Verify 2026 edition and grade-specific bibliography, especially PE102 grade I exclusion
Require genuinely independent qualified technical or legal AND linguistic reviewer, not a single-assistant check or a deterministic test
Only after explicit user permission propose canonical/app changes; no merge/release

gate_labels.P0_SOURCE_ORIGINAL_KEY_DISPUTE: Original Excel source-supported candidate letter disagrees with imported key, provisional; retain even if app rewrite masks it
gate_labels.P0_OTHER_HISTORIC_STRICT: Independent historic strict semantic/grade disagreement not already in the 19 source disputes
gate_labels.P0_MATERIAL_ORIGINAL_MUTATION: Material source-variant mutation if not already in P0; list invariant may count none
gate_labels.P1_NUMERIC_CELL_TYPE_FIDELITY: Source vs app numeric type only, verify UI semantics
gate_labels.P2_STANDARD_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW: All routine routes still require independent source, edition, options and cards
